t: You are looking at Beyond Tomorrow, a sculpture by Karin Jonzen. Jonzen was a British figure sculptor, born Karin Löwenadler, and she worked in bronze, terracotta and stone. Public bodies in Britain and abroad commissioned her work, which is why you can find her sculpture out in public places like this one. As a figure sculptor, she was interested in the human form, so it is worth walking around the piece and seeing how the figure reads from different sides.
